A28-3-intro.quote: Schedule 1 sets out the subject matter and duration of the processing, the nature and purpose of the processing, the types of Customer Personal Data and the categories of data subjects

A28-3-a.quote: Service Provider shall process Customer Personal Data only on documented instructions from Customer

A28-3-a2.quote: Service Provider shall promptly notify Customer if, in its opinion, an instruction infringes Data Protection Law

A28-3-c.quote: Service Provider shall implement and maintain the technical and organizational measures described in Schedule 2

A28-2.quote: Customer grants Service Provider a general authorization to engage the Subcontractors listed on the Subcontractor Page

A28-3-d.quote: Service Provider shall engage a Subcontractor only in accordance with this Section 6

A28-4.quote: Service Provider remains responsible to Customer for the acts and omissions of each Subcontractor

A28-3-e.quote: Service Provider shall assist Customer, by appropriate technical and organizational measures, in responding to requests from data subjects exercising their rights

A28-3-h.quote: Service Provider shall make available to Customer all information necessary to demonstrate compliance with Article 28 of the GDPR

defects.description: No assistance with security, breach notification to the authority, impact assessments or prior consultation (Articles 32 to 36). A plain breach notice to the Customer is present and must not count.
No deletion or return of Customer Personal Data at the end of the services.
